# `{upxdvir}` - Font Customisation

Font customisation is supported from presets offered by `{pxchfon}` such as the following:

1. `ipa`
1. `ipaex`
1. `haranoaji`
1. `sourcehan`
1. `noto`

Only `plain` and `bold` font faces are supported since Japanese glyphs are already monospaced.

```{r imports, message = FALSE}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
source("demo-helpers.R")
setKnitrPresets(4, 4)
```

## Font Families

```{r families, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
fontfamilies <- c("sourcehan", "serif", "noto", "ipaex", "haranoaji")
xs <- seq(.1, .9, by = .2)
invisible(mapply(
    \(x, fam, fac) {
        grid.latex(fam, x = x, y = .75)
        grid.uplatex(
        "これはフォントです。",
        x = x,
        gp = gpar(fontfamily = fam)
    )},
    xs, fontfamilies
))
```

## Font faces

```{r faces, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
invisible(mapply(
    \(x, fam, fac) {
        grid.latex(fam, x = x, y = .75)
        grid.uplatex(
        "これはフォントです。",
        x = x,
        gp = gpar(fontfamily = fam, fontface = "bold")
    )},
    xs, fontfamilies
))
```
